negative_rules.name: guard_expression.no_state_root
negative_rules.rule: State references are not allowed in guard expressions
negative_rules.reason: guards run before steps and only support input references and public probe references

negative_rules.name: guard_expression.no_step_root
negative_rules.rule: Registered step references are not allowed in guard expressions
negative_rules.reason: guards run before effectful step execution and therefore cannot depend on registered step results

negative_rules.name: guard_expression.no_filters
negative_rules.rule: Value-expression filters are not allowed in guard expressions
negative_rules.reason: guard expressions are a distinct probe/input language and do not evaluate value-expression filter pipelines

negative_rules.name: guard_expression.no_format_builtin
negative_rules.rule: The format builtin is not allowed in guard expressions
negative_rules.reason: guard expressions do not evaluate value-expression builtins

negative_rules.name: workflow_step.exactly_one_form
negative_rules.rule: A workflow step must define exactly one of uses, state_set, or state_delete
negative_rules.reason: step forms are mutually exclusive in the workflow contract

negative_rules.name: workflow_step.with_requires_uses
negative_rules.rule: The with field is allowed only together with uses
negative_rules.reason: runtime value inputs belong to operation-call step form only

negative_rules.name: workflow_step.register_requires_uses
negative_rules.rule: The register field is allowed only together with uses
negative_rules.reason: the MVP publishes registered step results only for operation-call steps

negative_rules.name: workflow_step.if_conflicts_with_register
negative_rules.rule: The if and register fields cannot be used together in the MVP
negative_rules.reason: the MVP avoids publishing synthetic registered step results for skipped conditional steps

negative_rules.name: value_expression.step_refs_must_be_backward
negative_rules.rule: Registered step references may target only earlier steps in the same workflow
negative_rules.reason: step-result reads are order-sensitive execution-local data flow rather than random access workflow state

negative_rules.name: state_set.single_target_entry
negative_rules.rule: state_set must contain exactly one target entry
negative_rules.reason: each state-set step writes one resolved state target at a time

negative_rules.name: format_value.args_must_be_list
negative_rules.rule: format-object args must be a list when provided
negative_rules.reason: format object arguments are evaluated positionally

operations.name: branch.switch
effects: switch current checkout to a local branch

operations.name: commit.create
effects: create a new commit from the current index

operations.name: commit.revert
effects: create a new commit that reverts a target commit

operations.name: integrate.cherry_pick
effects: apply a target commit onto the current checkout as a new commit

operations.name: integrate.merge
effects: integrate a target ref into the current checkout using merge semantics

operations.name: integrate.merge_ff_only
effects: integrate a target ref into the current checkout using fast-forward-only semantics

operations.name: integrate.rebase_onto
effects: rebase a non-default branch range onto a new base using rebase --onto semantics

operations.name: sync.fetch
effects: fetch refs from a remote into the local repository

operations.name: sync.push
effects: push a local branch to a remote

operations.name: issue.body.append
effects: append text to GitHub issue body

hints.name: profiles.prefer_for_environment_differences
hints.when: A workflow needs backend/frontend or environment-specific defaults without changing its core step graph
hints.because: Profiles separate environment-specific inputs and checks from the canonical workflow shape

hints.name: state.use_for_persistent_memory
hints.when: A workflow needs persistent memory across runs keyed by workflow inputs
hints.because: State bindings plus state_set/state_delete provide the runtime-owned persistent memory surface

hints.name: shell_command.use_as_capability_fallback
hints.when: A needed runtime action is not published as a dedicated connector capability
hints.because: shell.command is the explicit low-level fallback when no higher-level connector operation exists

participation_rules.publication_model: plugin metadata must enter introspection through the same public connector registry contract as built-in families

invalid_path_rules.name: key_reference_must_use_dotted_inputs
invalid_path_rules.message: state path key reference must use dotted inputs form such as 'inputs.issue_ref'

invalid_path_rules.name: no_trailing_content
invalid_path_rules.message: state path must not contain trailing content

runtime_rules.name: bound_role_required
runtime_rules.message: state role must be bound before runtime access

runtime_rules.name: scalar_key_required
runtime_rules.message: state key reference must resolve to a scalar value

runtime_rules.name: declared_location_required
runtime_rules.message: undeclared state locations are runtime errors

step_form_rules.name: exactly_one_step_form
step_form_rules.message: A workflow step must define exactly one of uses, state_set, or state_delete

step_form_rules.name: with_requires_uses
step_form_rules.message: The with field is allowed only together with uses
